8b2756f7b6.q: How did Rhea Cruz-Magpantay discover 1Heart Caregiver Services and decide to join the franchise?
8b2756f7b6.a: Rhea discovered 1Heart through a serendipitous connection on Facebook while searching LA Jobs, a placement company founded by Belina. 61bc16d776.q: How did the Eaton Fire in January 2025 impact Rhea Cruz-Magpantay's 1Heart franchise business in Pasadena?
61bc16d776.a: The Eaton Fire on January 7, 2025 devastated Rhea's business, wiping out one entire city in her territory and destroying about five major referring facilities and senior care centers that she worked with. Many clients in the affected area either moved away or lost their homes. Despite this major setback, Rhea's agency has recovered and bounced back, finding new referral partners and converting clients in neighboring territories by the end of 2025.

69405578dd.q: What training and support does 1Heart Caregiver Services provide to new franchisees and caregivers?
69405578dd.a: 1Heart offers a five-day new franchisee training program and hosts two to three annual summits and conferences via Zoom and webinars. For caregiver training, 1Heart Caregiver University provides baseline training slides that franchisees can customize. Rhea enhanced this by renting a monthly conference room at a local hotel starting in 2026 to conduct in-person trainings on the last Thursday of each month, which improved caregiver attendance and demonstrated the franchise's investment in employee development.
